options.name: Progression Balancing
options.doc:
A system that can move progression earlier, to try and prevent the player from getting stuck and bored early.

A lower setting means more getting stuck. A higher setting means less getting stuck.

options.name: Accessibility
options.doc:
Set rules for reachability of your items/locations.

**Full:** ensure everything can be reached and acquired.

**Minimal:** ensure what is needed to reach your goal can be acquired.

options.name: Goal
options.doc:
Choose the victory condition for this world.
Game Completion: The goal will be to defeat Liquid and escape Shadow Moses Island.
Boss Blitz: The goal will be to defeat a specific number of Bosses.
Dogtag Collection: The goal will be to collect a specific number of 'Dogtag' items which can be awarded for any location check.
Default: Game Completion
options.doc_fr:
Choisissez la condition de victoire pour ce monde.
Game Completion: L'objectif sera de vaincre Liquid et d'échapper à l'île Shadow Moses.
Boss Blitz: Le but sera de vaincre un certain nombre de Boss.
Dogtag Collection: L'objectif sera de recueillir un nombre spécifique d'articles «Dogtag» qui peuvent être attribués pour n'importe quel contrôle de localisation.
Default: Fin du jeu

options.name: Dogtags Required
options.doc:
Choose Dogtag Target.
If the goal of the run is Dogtag Collection, this will be the number of 'Dogtag' items required to win.
Default value: 30
options.doc_fr:
Choisissez Dogtag Target.
Si le but de la course est Dogtag Collection, ce sera le nombre d'éléments 'Dogtag' nécessaires pour gagner.
Default value: 30

options.name: Additional Dogtags
options.doc:
Assign extra Dogtags to be added to item pool.
If the goal of the run is Dogtag Collection, this will be the number of additional 'Dogtag' items added to the pool.
It's recommended to have a few to prevent softlocking.
Default value: 10
options.doc_fr:
Attribuer des Dogtags supplémentaires à ajouter au pool d'articles.
Si le but de la course est Dogtag Collection, ce sera le nombre d'éléments supplémentaires 'Dogtag' ajoutés à la piscine.
Il est recommandé d'en avoir quelques-uns pour empêcher le verrouillage.
Default value: 10

options.name: Bosses Required
options.doc:
Choose Boss Target.
If the goal of the run is Boss Blitz, this will be the number of Bosses required to beat in order to win.
There are 14 Bosses in total: Heavily Armed Genome Soldiers, Revolver Ocelot, M1 Tank, Gray Fox, Psycho Mantis, Sniper Wolf I, Black-outfitted Genome Soldiers I, A Hind D?, 
Stealth Camouflaged Genome Soldiers, Sniper Wolf II, Black-outfitted Genome Soldiers II, Vulcan Raven, Metal Gear REX, and Liquid Snake.
Default Value: 14
options.doc_fr:
Choisissez Boss Target.
Si le but de la course est Boss Blitz, ce sera le nombre de Boss requis pour battre pour gagner.
Il y a 14 Boss au total : Soldats Génomes très armés, Ocelot Revolver, Tank M1, Fox Gris, Psycho Mantis, Sniper Wolf I, Soldats Génomes Noirs I, A Hind D?, Soldats Génomes Volants Camouflés, Sniper Wolf II, Soldats Génomes Noirs II, Vulcan Raven, Metal Gear REX et Snake Liquide.
Default Value: 14
